title: Tactile reality: source manifest and authored relation candidates
scope: Supporting research for one approved expansion; independent material mechanics and art/photo practices. No source prose or images are proposed for runtime reuse.
method: Public web search/open of primary references. X seed URLs were supplied in the task. No social actions, generation, paid APIs, feed adapters, or repository edits.
provenance_notes: The three X seeds were inspected as public page text during prior topic-selection research in the cloud browser on 2026-09-30. Reopening through public web search in this batch failed. Prior observations are attributed below and do not constitute media-pixel review or platform-wide trend evidence.

An indexed third-party profile matched the general theme, but is excluded from the evidence set and all downstream content. It is not an approved SNS ingestion route under the repository's prompt-trend-scout policy.
These are authored abstractions. Exact visual cue combinations are design inferences from the references, not claims made by the sources.
No raw source text or media is included. Source URLs and authors stay in research provenance, not runtime prompts. Honor no_raw_reuse and no_republish for all artist examples.
Dates labeled undated are not inferred from search-engine crawl dates.

primary_sources.title: How paper folds: bending with local constraints
primary_sources.authors: Jemal Guven and Martin Michael Müller
primary_sources.support: Separates bending of an effectively inextensible sheet from stretch. Supports a fold axis, retained surface metric, and deformation localized by constraints.
primary_sources.limits: Idealized mechanics; not a universal account of every paper, crease fracture, or image-generation behavior

primary_sources.title: Geometric Mechanics of Curved Crease Origami
primary_sources.authors: Marcelo A. Dias, Levi H. Dudte, L. Mahadevan, Christian D. Santangelo
primary_sources.support: A curved crease can buckle a sheet into three dimensions; fold angle and sheet properties matter. Distinct curved-crease vocabulary can avoid every folded horizon looking like a straight book hinge.
primary_sources.limits: Annular-strip model; exact resulting shapes depend on geometry and material

primary_sources.title: Structures: Paper Bridges, page 3
primary_sources.support: Folding and rolling change structural stiffness. Useful for visibly supported pleats, tubes, coils and self-bearing folded terrain.
primary_sources.limits: Undated archived classroom explanation; not a numerical mechanics reference

primary_sources.title: Bending to kinetic energy transfer in adhesive peel front micro-instability
primary_sources.authors: V. De Zotti, K. Rapina, P.-P. Cortet, L. Vanel, S. Santucci
primary_sources.support: Peeling involves a detachment front, peel angle, backing stiffness and bent free strip. Supports keeping attached field, release line and lifted tail distinct.
primary_sources.limits: Microscale adhesive-tape experiment; giant scenery peel cues are an artistic analogy, not scale-validated physics

primary_sources.title: The coarsening of folds in hanging drapes
primary_sources.authors: Peter Bella and Robert V. Kohn
primary_sources.support: Hanging sheets combine gravity with constrained top folds; fold scale changes down the drape. Supports grip/anchor-dependent gathering and sag.
primary_sources.limits: Idealized thin-sheet model, restricted assumptions including zero Poisson ratio; do not claim all cloth obeys one exact fold pattern

primary_sources.title: To begin with, what's the structure of a zipper?
primary_sources.support: Paired elements, slider and fabric tapes have distinct roles. A Y-shaped slider passage separates or joins tracks, supporting a causal opening front.
primary_sources.limits: Undated explanatory page; orientation words such as up/down are example-dependent, so use ahead/behind relative to travel

primary_sources.title: Glass Cutting Basics
primary_sources.inspection: Read indexed PDF text and manufacturer landing page
primary_sources.support: A wheel first scores a fissure, then pressure runs the fracture. Supports score-and-split as different from scissors cutting a soft sheet; tool contact and rigid shard edges matter.
primary_sources.limits: Cold sheet-glass practice, not molten or intentionally flexible fantasy glass; no need to import studio instructions or product brands into prompts

primary_sources.title: Lygia Clark. The Inside Is the Outside. 1963
primary_sources.support: Hinged metal planes create manipulable, unstable configurations. Supports panel articulation and maintained joints as separate from soft folds.
primary_sources.limits: Interpretation of a specific artwork, not a request to reproduce it; no image reuse

primary_sources.title: Slashes (1958–1968)
primary_sources.support: A cut surface and controlled darkness behind it create a material opening. Supports paired cut lips and recessed field, distinct from a flat drawn line.
primary_sources.limits: Historical art evidence; avoid copying a composition or claiming every slit must have black backing

primary_sources.title: Rise & Shine — Behind the Scenes
primary_sources.support: Artist describes constructing a thick physical shadow-shaped cutout with surface debris. Grounds a shadow becoming an object with a sidewall, underside and its own contact/cast-shadow evidence.
primary_sources.limits: Specific production account; abstract the role transition, do not reproduce the artwork or reuse media

primary_sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions: stages of creating a photo
primary_sources.support: Planning considers perspective, reflections, material and light; matching light and viewpoint across photographed components is central. Supports a coherence gate around hand, transformed sheet, and environment.
primary_sources.limits: Page has mixed update history; no precise date asserted. Personal works are not offered for commercial licensing; use private abstraction only

primary_sources.title: All Above the Sky — Behind the Scenes
primary_sources.support: A location and a later model capture were lit consistently. Supports grounded practical-photography language rather than generic quality adjectives.
primary_sources.limits: Specific image-making example, not a generation benchmark; no visual copying

primary_sources.title: Geometry Playground: The geometry of seeing
primary_sources.support: Shadows are projections and reflected appearance depends on geometry and viewpoint. Supports separating displaced physical shadow-objects from ordinary shadows and preserving optical consistency.
primary_sources.limits: Undated overview, not full ray-tracing documentation

essential_roles: retained anchor, joint, or attached remainder
relation_schema.core_rule: The material behavior is caused by an identifiable operation at an identifiable contact, while recognizable scene content remains mapped onto the manipulated surface.
relation_schema.novelty_test: Would the scene still have the same meaning if the hand/tool/contact or material response vanished? If yes, it may be only generic surrealism or a material swap.
relation_schema.hierarchy: Make one operation readable first; supporting details confirm it instead of introducing competing mechanisms.

authored_candidates.roles: grip -> free tail -> curved peel front -> still-adhered field -> revealed substrate
visual_cues: pinched edge exposing front and reverse
tight curvature where adhesion releases
attached field remains flat
shadow narrows toward the peel front
negatives: floating detached sheet with no peel origin
paper tear mistaken for clean delamination
hidden scene bleeding through the still-adhered area

authored_candidates.roles: hand/tool -> lifted flap -> retained fold axis -> unaltered plane
visual_cues: one continuous hinge line
surface landmarks bend with the flap
reverse side becomes visible
fold cavity contains consistent occlusion
negatives: whole environment translating as one block

authored_candidates.roles: opposed pushes -> alternating ridges/valleys -> compacted world strip
visual_cues: repeated mountain and valley folds
narrowing footprint with preserved strip length
alternating lit faces and shaded troughs
negatives: random crumpling with no compression direction

authored_candidates.roles: hand or roller -> cylindrical core -> incoming sheet -> exposed ground
visual_cues: tangent entry into roll
successive visible layer thickness at roll ends
same terrain or sky motifs continue around curvature
negatives: ocean wave curl without sheet edge
cylinder unrelated to the flat field

authored_candidates.roles: grip -> tensioned region -> counter-anchor -> slack remainder
visual_cues: pull direction readable from geometry
wrinkles converge toward grasp or fastening points
strained zone distinct from slack folds
negatives: uniform melting mistaken for tensile deformation
authored_candidates.limits: Elastic stretch is an authored contrast candidate; these sources mostly constrain how to distinguish it from inextensible paper and hanging drape, not a quantitative rubber model

authored_candidates.roles: hand or ring -> gathered point -> suspended fabric field -> hanging hem
visual_cues: dense local folds around the gathered point
looser hanging folds farther away
weighted lower edge and visible hem

authored_candidates.roles: hand -> pull tab -> slider -> joined seam / separated paired tapes
visual_cues: slider sits exactly at the change from joined to parted tracks
teeth remain paired and attached to surface edges

authored_candidates.roles: blade or fingers -> incision -> two material lips -> recessed field
visual_cues: clean bounded cut ends
paired cut edges show surface thickness
depth indicated by occlusion and back surface

authored_candidates.roles: opposed grips -> advancing tear tip -> two complementary irregular edges
visual_cues: force directions diverge at the tear
fibrous or ragged margin appropriate to material
remaining bridge ahead of tear tip
negatives: both edges having incompatible missing shapes
authored_candidates.limits: Original design inference; fibrous tearing specifics are not established by the cited bending paper. Keep source claim narrow.

authored_candidates.roles: lever or suction grip -> rigid plate -> supporting edge or joint -> recess
visual_cues: plate stays planar
sidewall or edge thickness remains constant
reflected scene changes by plate orientation
one pivot/support is readable
negatives: paper-white reverse assumed for all glazing
reflection painted on independent of orientation

authored_candidates.roles: scoring wheel -> continuous score -> applied bend/pressure -> running fracture -> rigid parts
visual_cues: narrow score ahead of separation
clean rigid facets after fracture
edge glints and thickness
negatives: soft ribbon stretch during cold fracture

authored_candidates.roles: original caster -> shadow-shaped material -> grasped edge -> newly exposed ground -> secondary physical shadow
visual_cues: the dark shape has actual sidewall/underside
lifted section casts a separate shadow consistent with scene light
source-caster relationship remains legible
negatives: duplicate silhouettes with no materialization cue
dark paint smudge called a lifted object

cross_cutting_checks: Contact: the thumb, clamp, hook, suction cup, wheel or blade actually meets the material; no hovering tool.
Force: the response starts at contact and connects to a credible retained point or counterforce.
Continuity: recognizable front-side imagery follows deformation; do not introduce an unrelated prop with scenery printed on it unless that is the intended relation.
Underside: distinguish reverse face, layer thickness and revealed world. They are three different things.
Occlusion: the lifted flap hides parts of the world behind it; the opening is not merely overlaid.
Light: hand, tool, free material and environment share light direction and perspective. Contact darkness and cast shadow should agree with geometry.
Material: paper bends/creases; cloth gathers/drapes; elastic membrane stretches; rigid glass remains planar before fracture. If intentionally crossing behaviors, state the material change explicitly.
Boundary: keep this separate from portals, generic melting, floating architecture, material texture swaps, ordinary paper dioramas and screen/photo-border escapes.
Scale: small operator versus enormous coherent field can supply the surreal scale relation, but tactile manipulation need not always use a giant hand.
Do not use all cues in every prompt; choose cues that prove the specific operation.
optional_candidates_needing_further_grou: Scrape/erase a coating: removal front, accumulated shavings or residue, reveal of underlying field. Potentially overlaps surface erasure and repainting themes.
Wring/twist a flexible horizon: two torqued grips, helical stress folds and narrowed middle. Needs a direct torsion/fabric reference.
Unbutton or unlace architecture: individual fastening points and flap overlap; treat as joining topology, not zipper synonym.
